text: Great question! Your vault is protected by serious, multi-layered security that works quietly in the background. Everything in your vault is encrypted with AES-256, the same military-grade standard trusted by banks and governments around the world. Your encryption key is created from your master password using PBKDF2 with 600,000 iterations, which makes guessing your password extremely slow and expensive for attackers, even with powerful hardware. And here's the best part: your master password never leaves your device. Our servers never see it, so there's nothing for a hacker to steal from us. Only encrypted data is stored in the cloud, and only you hold the key to unlock it. That means you get fast, convenient access to your passwords across all your devices, with privacy built right in. Your digital life deserves this kind of protection, and we're proud to deliver it!
